:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
#### [Actin conformation dynamics precede force generation in cytotoxic T lymphocytes](<https://doi.org/10.1038/s42003-026-11011-3>)

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
#### [Reprogrammable origami through bistable buckled hinges](<http://arxiv.org/abs/2609.28790v1>)

:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
#### [A principal-stress rule for cell division in epithelia](<https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-026-77813-5>)
*Lucas Anger, Tianxiang Ma, Fanny Wodrascka, Andreas Schoenit, Kristian Thijssen, Satish Kailasam Mani, Marc-Antoine Fardin, Carine Rossé, René-Marc Mège, Amin Doostmohammadi, Benoit Ladoux* <br>

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
